reason: The hypothesis restates the central finding and mechanism of P1 and P13 almost verbatim: that restricted atomic mobility during reduction of a five-element noble metal precursor forces random co-nucleation and single-phase alloy formation despite sequential reduction, and that slower cooling leads to phase separation. The proposed controlled comparison and falsification test are logical extensions of the same idea but do not add a new mechanistic insight or combine disparate sources.
copied_elements: rapid heating/quenching to restrict atomic mobility
sequentially reduced elements forming single-phase alloy
dilution of local concentration prevents segregation
comparison of fast vs. slow cooling on phase separation
